market_summary: All four assets are consolidating inside or around primary value areas and session VWAPs ahead of the New York open. EURUSD and GBPUSD show fading momentum following tests of local highs, US100 remains coiled in a tight mid-range compression band, and BTCUSD is pressing near session lows without the RVOL volume expansion required for a safe breakdown scalp. High discipline requires HOLD across the board.

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10779, VAH 1.10998) and currently hovering near POC 1.10943. CVD is BULLISH (+4,112) but has a negative short-term slope (-1199.27), indicating waning momentum after failing to break above Session High 1.11027. Signal candle rejected above EMA50/EMA20 baseline and forming bar is pulling back towards VWAP 1.10861. Volatility is contracting mid-channel without RVOL confirmation (last RVOL 0.964, no yellow bars). London session chop inside the value area warrants a HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32599, VAH 1.32797) and below POC 1.32738. CVD is BEARISH (-3,375) with an accelerating negative slope (-2035.97), agreeing with downward pressure. Price sits directly on session VWAP 1.32671 and support S/R 1.32661, below EMA20 and EMA50. While RVOL is elevated at 1.719, there is no clean break below VWAP/support yet and no yellow RVOL spike >2.0 to confirm an expansion break toward Session Low 1.3250. Given the mid-range positioning in London session, HOLD is appropriate until clear support acceptance or breakdown.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28086.57, VAH 28190.28) and just above POC 28117.21. Close is slightly above session VWAP 28132.50 but below EMA20 baseline 28145.11 and EMA50 28163.88. CVD is BEARISH (-2.93) with negative slope (-0.75). Volume is average (RVOL 0.825, noting Dukascopy index CFD tick volume caveat). The market is stuck in a compression range between S/R 28100.36 and EMA50/VAH during London Session ahead of NY cash open. GEX is null. Lacking directional edge and volume catalyst, HOLD is required.

Price is trading below VAL 73358.62 and below POC 73522.35, firmly beneath session VWAP 73594.73 and EMA50 73581.53. CVD is BEARISH (-0.05) with negative slope (-0.01). However, price is resting right on top of Session Low 73166.0 and near the lower ATR band 73097.45 / Prev Low 73097.3 with no yellow RVOL expansion bars (RVOL 0.812). Entering short into immediate local low support without breakout momentum carries high risk of a liquidity sweep bounce, while longs lack structure. Hence, HOLD is the disciplined stance.
